item.title: Coral experts unite in historic effort to restore Florida's coral reef
item.description: Throughout the first week of August, 12 organizations came together in an unprecedented collaborative effort to protect the future of Florida's Coral Reef during one of nature's most elusive events: coral spawning. Scientists across the organizations worked tirelessly to propagate and conserve the next generation of corals by collecting eggs and sperm (gametes), strategically fertilizing embryos and cryopreserving sperm to safeguard invaluable genetic diversity for generations to come. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Astronomers catch hot birth of galaxy cluster more than 11 billion light-years away
item.description: Astronomers have detected an enormous cloud of gas tens of millions of degrees hot surrounding one of the most extreme structures known in the early universe. The study offers one of the clearest views yet of a galaxy cluster in the making. Using more than 600,000 seconds of observations with NASA's Chandra X-ray Observatory, the team found diffuse, extended X-ray emission around a quasar embedded in a dense concentration of galaxies more than 11 billion light-years away. The paper describing the results was published in Astronomy & Astrophysics on July 24. Fuente: Phys.org.
